rule_text: A name is counted when it was on the 🩳 list before the session — listed by his scanner on one of the 2 market days before it. It ran when its 09:30–20:00 high was at least +40% over the prior session's last regular 5-minute close; premarket never counts. Short interest is the settlement FINRA had published before the day (7 business days after settlement); a name with none is not recorded. ⛔ is the SSR record as of 04:00 ET that day (on at the open) and as of 20:15 ET (triggered that day); a day with no record reads not known. A pattern reads only with at least 20 names and 20 days on each side; the interval is drawn on names and on days and must clear 0 on both. Recorded at 20:15 ET; a missed day, a later bar read and the next-session columns are filled within 10 market days. Names first listed that day are shown apart and never counted.
honesty: A ledger of what happened, not a test: only names on the list before the day are counted; the sample is small, one market regime, the same name repeats across days and the days share one market; the patterns were chosen after looking at this kind of data. The prior close is the last regular 5-minute bar, not the exchange's closing print, so a ✅ here can differ from the 📅 chip near the line. The noon fade, the after-hours ramp, the VWAP reclaim and the within-day shuffle are MINE. Days recorded late carry no 🔒 📄 ✂️ fields, and ⛔ reads not known where the SSR record was never read. UNMEASURED. Not advice.
